name: Farewell, Wanderlust
source:
"If you could go anywhere, where would it be?"

"Somewhere that isn't here."

No matter what you try, you can't stop thinking about that memory. After years of living in your hometown, you decide to go on a journey. What kind of journey? You don't exactly know, but that's the point.

[From [url=https://chellaytiger.itch.io/farewell-wanderlust]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“如果你可以去任何地方，你会去哪里？”

“某个不在这里的地方。”

无论你如何尝试，你都无法停止思考那段记忆。在家乡生活了多年后，你决定去旅行。什么样的旅程？你并不完全知道，但这就是重点。
